name: Jelly Radio
description: Pill-style radio group where the selected chip swells and neighbors get pushed aside and squish with a springy, staggered jelly motion. Supports keyboard navigation and controlled use.
contents: Radiogroup of pill chips, each with a label and optional icon
Default items: Off, Low, Medium, High, Max
behavior: Selected chip scales up while other chips shrink slightly and shift away from it
Spring animation with stagger by distance from the selection and a squash-and-stretch jelly feel
Arrow keys, Home, End, Space and Enter change the selection, keyboard changes apply instantly without animation
Hover tint on inactive chips on pointer devices, press scale on click
Supports controlled (value) and uncontrolled (defaultValue) use, and RTL direction
Respects reduced motion by jumping to the final state
editableByProps: Options, labels, icons, per-item disabled state and selected value
Chip, active, text and active text colors, corner radius, gap and size (sm, md, lg)
Motion feel: swell, barge, shrink, jelly, bounce, stagger, stiffness
Disabled state, aria label and extra class names

needsCodeEdit.change: Add or change the size presets
Change the hover tint strength on inactive chips
needsCodeEdit.where: before:opacity-[0.11] class on the inner span in the Chip render

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the press scale or color transition timing
needsCodeEdit.where: className of the inner span (group-active/chip:scale-[0.97] and transform/background transitions)

fixed: Requires the motion package and Tailwind CSS, styling is done through Tailwind utility classes and CSS variables
Layout is a single horizontal inline row that does not wrap, so many or long items can overflow narrow screens
Group padding is measured at runtime and set as CSS variables on the group element
Keyboard selection is always instant, mouse clicks animate
Listens to ResizeObserver and document fonts ready to re-measure
